course.eras.scout.chapter.desc: On every cell the robot runs the same circuit board, and a finished board becomes a component.
course.eras.scout.chapter.title: Build a machine
glossary.entries.board.body.0: The rule for one cell: wired once, the robot runs it on every cell.
glossary.entries.board.title: circuit board
glossary.groups.robot.title: The robot
level.copy.debrief.body.0: The circuit board is the rule: you write it once, and the robot uses it on every cell.
level.copy.debrief.title: The robot learned to copy
level.copy.intro.0.t: The robot walks through the whole table cell by cell and runs the same <wiki-ref to="board"></wiki-ref> on every cell.
level.copy.mission.goal: Have the robot copy the number in the leftmost cell, cell by cell, all the way to the right.
level.copy.mission.how: Click “left” in the view and wire it to “this cell”.
level.copy.short: Click a cell, wire it in
level.copy.tasks.copy.hints.0: Click “left” in the view, then wire it to “this cell”.
level.copy.title: Robot relay
level.merge.debrief.body.0: You drew three wires and the robot filled in the whole city.
level.merge.debrief.title: The robot runs the city
level.merge.intro.0.t: A Merger adds up the numbers its wires bring; “—” is left out.
level.merge.mission.goal: The start already holds 1. Have the robot work out the routes to every crossing: up + left.
level.merge.mission.how: Wire “up” and “left” into one Merger, then the Merger to “this cell”.
level.merge.short: Merge two numbers in one component
level.merge.showcase: the first part placed on a board: it sits between the inputs and the output and gathers several ways in into one number
level.merge.tasks.merge.hints.0: Wire both inputs into the same Merger.
level.merge.title: Two roads meet
level.rocks.debrief.body.0: The part stays as it is; a gate outside it is enough.
level.rocks.debrief.title: The gate outside the part
level.rocks.intro.0.t: Routes can’t pass through rocks: a rock cell has “—” routes.
level.rocks.mission.goal: Count the routes to every crossing, rock cells left out.
level.rocks.mission.how: Count with the Route Counter, and block the result on rock cells.
level.rocks.short: Add a gate outside the part
level.rocks.tasks.rocks.hints.0: Wire “is rock” to the Block gate’s condition and the Route Counter into its number.
level.rocks.title: Rockfall
level.stamp.debrief.body.0: From now on this board is a part: the Route Counter.
level.stamp.debrief.title: The board is a part
level.stamp.intro.0.t: Streets only go right or down. The routes to a crossing = up + left, and the start is 1.
level.stamp.mission.goal: Have the robot write 1 on the start and up + left on every other crossing.
level.stamp.mission.how: A Merger takes up and left; a Pass gate lets a 1 in at the start only.
level.stamp.short: Merge two ways in, spot the start
level.stamp.tasks.stamp.hints.0: Wire “is start” to the Pass gate’s condition and a Constant 1 to its number, then the gate into the Merger.
level.stamp.title: Count the routes
piece.counter.desc: Adds up the numbers on its two ways in, plus 1 when its “start” port is “yes”.
piece.counter.name: Route Counter
